items.summary: When an admin blocks a user, automatically cancel and remove all existing reservations and bookings made by that blocked user across all screenings. The backend must enforce this so that blocked users have no active reservations after being blocked.

After an admin accepts or denies a ticket/reservation in the ReservationManager UI, immediately refresh the reservation list and seat plan data without requiring a manual page reload. Invalidate and refetch all relevant React Query caches (reservations, seat plan) upon mutation success or failure.

Optimize the ticket acceptance flow in the ReservationManager to reduce perceived latency. Apply optimistic UI updates so the reservation status changes immediately on click, with a rollback if the backend call fails. Show a loading indicator on the action button that was clicked to prevent duplicate submissions.

After an admin blocks a user, trigger a backend-side cleanup that also invalidates and refetches the reservation list and seat plan on the frontend, so the admin immediately sees blocked users' bookings disappear from the UI.
